info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v5-spec
info.description: The Guest Pass Listing API enables businesses to retrieve a comprehensive list of available guest passes for fitness memberships. This endpoint is essential for gyms and fitness centers looking to manage and display guest access options for potential clients. Developers can utilize this API to integrate guest pass details into mobile applications or web platforms, enhancing user engagement and onboarding processes. Typical consumers include fitness centers, gym management systems, and third-party wellness applications aiming to offer promotional access to prospective members.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve available guest passes for memberships. You can check the status, validity, and details of guest passes provided to members.

requestBody.description: A request body for retrieving details about guest passes associated with memberships. This body is expected in JSON format and contains necessary parameters to filter or identify the specific guest passes required.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the guest pass details.
